messages:
Carla (PM): Putting together a conservative rollout plan for the 'priority-holdbacks' feature. Goals: enable controlled A/B for premium tenants, limit cost/regression blast radius, and provide instant rollback by tenant. Looking for ops + metrics constraints.
Nina (Eng): Proposal: feature flag hierarchy (global -> region -> tenant). Bake A/B by traffic slice within tenant (50/50) for initial experiments, then promote whole-tenant when we hit success criteria.
Raj (SRE): Must add infra-level caps: per-tenant token-rate cap, global ramp rate (no more than 20% new traffic shift per hour), and a short-term shed path that fails open to the legacy router.
Leo (Data): Success metric(s): conversion uplift (goal +5% for premium routing) AND no increase in tail latency beyond +10% p95. Measurement window: 6h rolling after promotion. Need a control cohort and confidence interval (use bootstrap).
Mei (CS): Customers will want to opt into early-stage tests. Can we support a pin that places a tenant into either control or treatment permanently for the experiment period? Also need automatic notifications when quarantine happens.
Nina (Eng): Yes, add per-tenant pin API and audit log. Implementation detail: feature store flags + eviction TTL for quarantines. Also suggest adding a "soft-traffic" mode for non-critical tenants (max 10% of their requests).
Carla (PM): Draft rollout matrix below. Comments?
```yaml
feature: priority_holdbacks
phases:
  - name: internal_canary
    tenants: [redwood-infra, redwood-dev]
    traffic_slice: 100%
    monitor_window: 2h
  - name: seeded-experiments
    percent_tenants: 2
    tenant_mode: split-traffic
    success_criteria:
      - conversion_delta: >= 5%
      - latency_p95_delta: <= 10%
  - name: tenant-promote
    percent_tenants: 15
    tenant_mode: full-traffic
    monitor_window: 24h
  - name: regional-scale
    percent_tenants: 60
    regions: [us-east-1, eu-west-1]
  - name: global
    percent_tenants: 100
safety:
  quarantine:
    trigger:
      - error_rate: > 0.01 for 5m
      - latency_p95: > baseline * 2 for 10m
    action: pin-to-control, notify-CS, ttl: 15m
  infra_caps:
    per_tenant_qps_multiplier: 1.5
    global_ramp_pct_per_hour: 20
observability:
  dashboards: [tenant-health, experiment-delta, region-coverage]
  alerts: [quarantine-event, infra-cap-breach]
```
Leo (Data): Add an automatic sanity check that refuses to promote a tenant if the control group sample size < 5000 requests in the monitor window. Otherwise signals will be noisy.
Raj (SRE): Operational note: implement a kill-switch at the routing layer that can be toggled by SRE during incidents. Also require deploy-bot to emit a small post when each phase starts.
deploy-bot: priority_holdbacks feature flagged in staging by Nina at 2141601288 :white_check_mark:
Mei (CS): Also request we provide a webhook payload sample for CS integrations (tenant, reason, timestamp, suggested_action).
Nina (Eng): Action items: 1) implement per-tenant pin + split API; 2) infra cap enforcement + kill-switch; 3) telemetry gating service to enforce EWMA guards and min-sample; 4) dashboard mock.
Carla (PM): Decision: proceed with seeded-experiments stage after internal canary passes. CS to prepare opt-in flows and webhooks. SRE to own infra caps and kill-switch. Meeting tomorrow 09:30 to finalize SLA wording and rollout timeline. :spiral_calendar:
